bombs.signature_recognizable: Partly. The orange flash, the black V-fan crown at 0.4-1 s and the fragment puffs now read close to Saber Strike refs a and c (FIXED since the c3 review: no pom-pom on a stalk, no tree, framing at 22% with the crown filling about 35-40% of the width). From 2 s on it is again a cartoon storm cloud floating over bare ground, the same object as Mk 84, Tallboy and Grand Slam. The 7 m crater shows as a blue sliver in the near view.

issues.problem: [REMAINS, sev 3 in c3] The crown is fully opaque and black, standing on the ground at 1 s. By 2 s it has vanished: col_fade 0.9 takes stem density to 0 by 1.8 s. A black cotton ball hangs 25-30 m up with clean sky and a few clods under it (zoom and near 2 s), then floats as an isolated cloud at 4-60 s with nothing linking it to the ground. Expect a visible pop in motion. There is no dust fall-out veil, no dirty trail and no downwind stretch. The dossier asks for a 'lumpy black to grey-brown puff that rises and drifts' out of the crown. This floating-ball grammar is identical on bombs 1-4.
issues.fix: Implement the col_veil code request. In explosion_profile.gd _column_stem, when t > col_fade, return bottom -5, top = head center_y - 0.3*half, radius = 0.45*head radius, flare 1.0, density = col_veil[2]*(1 - smoothstep(col_veil[0], col_veil[1], t)). In explosion.gd pass stem_wake.z = 0 for it (no jets). For mk82 use col_veil=[1.2, 20.0, 0.35] and col_fade 0.9->1.6, so the crown sags into the veil instead of vanishing. In shader head_density add q.x /= 1.0 + 0.015*age along the wind direction for column kinds.

issues.problem: [NEW] A straight, hard horizontal line cuts across the puff: lit tan above, dark grey below. Zoom 15 s at x=880 drops from 98 to 81 within 6 px, and the line is visible at x 820-1000. It reads as two stacked plates. Likely cause: proxy-box clipping. explosion.gd _update_volume sizes the head box as hr + head_noise_amp*1.6*hh, but head_lobes=1 puts lobes out to 1.10R and the shader displacement reaches head_noise_amp*min(R,1.8H)*~1.1 beyond that. Rays then exit through a box face and lose the far part of the puff, and the projected box edge shows as a straight line.
issues.fix: explosion.gd _update_volume, head bounds: var amp_s := float(prof.a("head_noise_amp",0.3))*minf(hr, hh*1.8)*1.2 + hh*0.3; var exh := hr*1.15 + amp_s; mn/mx x,z = -/+exh; y = center_y -/+ (hh*1.1 + amp_s). Verify with a test render at box x1.5: the line must move or vanish. Secondary: cheap_density's head term is noise-free, so its shadow follows the smooth ellipsoid. Displace it with low-frequency noise: -(sdf_head(p) - (nlf(p/(H*1.2)+seed)-0.5)*H*0.8).

issues.problem: [REMAINS in a new form: the colour is FIXED (orange, no cream cumulus), the look is not] The ball is a flat matte pastel-orange cut-out (about RGB 220,160,98) with an airbrushed, perfectly smooth radial white disc in the middle. That disc is the new impact-parameter gradient (fb_grad: tloc*mix(1.30,0.75,b_fb)), and it reads as a 2D sticker or lens flare pasted on a paper silhouette (near 0.06 s). The ball has no turbulent hot cells, no saturated orange limb with darker tongues, and no black soot on one side until 0.15 s, when the soot is symmetric left/right wings. Ref b: yellow-white turbulent core, ragged flame tongues, soot on one side, all within frames.

issues.problem: [REMAINS: c3 'loaf with vertical end walls'] The skirt ends in perfectly vertical walls: zoom 2 s at x=445 and x=1258, zoom 4 s right end, and a straight slanted cut at the left end in the near 2 s view. The near 4/8 s view shows a solid sand-heap mound. Cause: sdf_skirt has no radial bound. Beyond 1.25R, hh=0, so noise keeps a thin ground sheet out to infinity, and only the proxy box (kr+kh) stops it with a hard face.
issues.fix: explosion_volume.gdshader sdf_skirt: add d = max(d, r - R*1.3 - h*0.5) and use a softer toe: prof *= 1.0 - smoothstep(0.85, 1.3, x). explosion.gd skirt bounds: mn/mx x,z = -/+(kr*1.32 + kh*1.5), top kh*2.6. mk82: dust density fade by 6 s (surge/skirt tau), so no heap remains at 8 s.

bombs.signature_recognizable: Weakly. 'No fireball' is right, and the 0.6 s dark spray plus the 3-5 s column with a base surge read as a buried burst. The heave beat is a blank frame at 0.15 s and a speck at 0.3 s. There is no spiky radial-jet crown, no grey-white smoke, no clods on arcs and no readable crater. issues.problem: [REMAINS, with new CG artefacts] At 8 s the collapsed column becomes a flat dark-brown disc hovering just above the surge, its top dissolving into horizontal smear streaks (a 'hamburger patty' or UFO) under a pall floating 100+ m higher with empty sky between (zoom and near 8 s). At 15 s the pall contains a hard-edged dark RECTANGLE (zoom x 940-1045, y 205-290: straight top, vertical left side). At 60 s it shows two stacked straight horizontal terminators, like pancakes. The dossier calls for a fallback curtain and a brown base surge out to 100-200 m that merges with a dirty brown-grey cloud.
issues.fix: (1) The rectangle and lines are head proxy-box clipping. head_noise_amp 0.6 with cap_aspect 0.4 needs a box of about 1.57R horizontally, but the box gives 1.38R. Use the systemic box formula. (2) Collapse: _column_stem shrinks h after col_fall while the noise y is divided by stem_col.w, so the noise is squashed into horizontal streaks. Keep h at the peak and collapse as a curtain instead: st["hollow"] = clampf((t-tf)/col_fall_time,0,1)*0.6 and dens *= 1 - smoothstep(0.0, 1.0, (t-tf)/(col_fall_time*1.5)) applied from the top down (multiply by smoothstep(h*(1-k), h*(1-k)-0.3h, p.y) via stem_wake.y). (3) col_veil=[6.0, 40.0, 0.3] so the pall stays linked to the surge.

issues.problem: [NEW, c2 'black shadows' class] The crown and column split exactly down the middle into two materials. The left half is a flat, detail-less near-black (zoom 1 s mean about RGB 38,38,36) and the right half is tan (60-110). It looks like a black cut-out glued to a sand cut-out. Real dust columns at noon have grey-brown shadow sides at about 45-60% of the lit side with visible billows. Cause: macro_s takes its normal from normalize(p.xz) even deep inside the semi-transparent column, together with a 0.45 floor and a weak ambient term.

Raise the ao floor for dust: ao = exp(...)*0.55 + 0.45. Add ground bounce to stem samples: light += ground_col*sun_c*max(L.y,0)*0.45*(1-hgt).

systemic: PROXY-BOX CLIPPING (sev 2, all four bombs; the root cause of most remaining hard CG edges). explosion.gd _update_volume bounds are too tight. (a) Head: hr + head_noise_amp*1.6*hh, but head_lobes=1 puts lobes out to 1.10R and the shader displacement adds head_noise_amp*min(R,1.8H)*~1.1. Result: straight horizontal terminators across late clouds (Mk 82 15/60 s, Mk 84 30/60 s, Tallboy 60 s) and the dark rectangle in Tallboy 15 s. (b) Stem: sr*max(flare,1+cone)*1.6, while density reaches 2x the local cone radius. Result: the straight diagonal cut on the Mk 84 0.4 s soot wing. (c) Skirt: kr+kh, while sdf_skirt has no radial bound (hh=0 beyond 1.25R leaves an infinite thin noisy sheet). Result: the vertical end walls on every skirt and surge (Mk 82 2 s, Mk 84 4/15 s, Tallboy 3-15 s, Grand Slam 5-15 s). Fix: head ext_xz = hr*1.15 + amp_s, ext_y = hh*1.1 + amp_s with amp_s = head_noise_amp*min(hr,1.8hh)*1.2 + 0.3hh; stem se factor 1.6 -> 2.2; sdf_skirt d = max(d, r - 1.3R - 0.5h) and skirt box +/-(1.32kr + 1.5kh), top 2.6kh. Verify by rendering once with every box at x1.5: any line that moves is a clip.

COMPRESSION MISMATCH (root cause of neon rings, mustard skies and halos). The ball's emission is soft-compressed in explosion_volume (lum /= 1+lum*g_exposure/6), but everything the ball lights uses the UNCOMPRESSED g_fireball_color.w or bb_lum: the condensation sheets (volume line ~708), the sky aureole and near-field glow (atmos.gdshaderinc atm_fireball_glow), the sky flash (sky.gdshader), and the shock condensation. So the secondaries are as bright as, or brighter than, the ball: Bravo's white neon discs, the orange/mustard whole-sky veils of Mike and Tsar at 0.1-20 s, and glare discs that swallow the 219/Tsar balls. Fix: compute one compressed intensity on the CPU (inten_c = inten/(1+inten*3*exposure/6)) for g_fireball_color.w, and apply flc = fl/(1+fl*g_exposure/6) in the volume sheet term.
